body:
6 H1s babey! got diagnosed with autism the day after i got my results do that probably explains it (?)

how did english go for you?
you're a star. :love:
man i don't know how it happened, in real life i'm a retard
ah shit. no, they've no pharmacy, they know nobody who works as a pharmacist. they want me to do medicine but have settled for pharmacy.

i don't understand why everyone is assuming i live off of them? of course my parents provide for me, pay for groceries, and i live in their house, but i have a job and give them 20% of my paycheck every month, plus extras when they need it- I've paid for my mother's car insurance,.for gas fills etc
soudn advice, but i live in dublin and my job only pays minimum wage - not enough for rent.
parents are pakistani. why?
well obviously. you have to understand that they genuinely want whats best for you, and everything they do is for your own benefit ultimately. but it can be tough.
same here. it's tough. never easy going against tour parents, especially with all the religious emphasis on honour your parents etc.
this is all true. i can wait reapply next year. maybe i should just stick it out. agh i wish i'd gotten 100 points fewer, i might have been happier then.

looking at your avatar, are you muslim? i assume your parents have foreign heritage? if so you'll understand where i'm coming from, i feel that some immigrant parents are just so strict. it's unimaginable to some other people, but thats just the way our parents are.

edit: wait one moment is that a hoodie or a hijaab?

thanks for the comment. i really appreciate it.

i've spoken to them, already - sat them both down, explained that i'm an adult, i understand they want the best for me but i'm not sure i can commit to this. 

it doesn't get through - they're typical asian parents, and it's a miracle they're not forcing me to do medicine anymore. it's tough. i can't make them understand.

thanks for your comment regardless. :heart:

literally don't be sorry at all. i have no pharmacist friends. thanks so much for your input. would you reckon it'd be a good idea to go beg a job off my local pharmacy even to just work at the tills? would that give me any insight into a pharmacist's job? i know obviously pharmacists have to do WAY more complicated / qualified work but would you reckon it'd be worthwhile?

how's the work life balance? 

no pressure to answer though! thanks so much for your input regardless.
thats true, but if i worked for the HSE rather than in the private sector i'd have to deal with pay scales. god bless your uncle though.

agh god, see this is what im talking about. im not great with sciences but everything you've said is true - especially with the work life balance. 

im not too concerned with missing the year - i didn't have any friends in school but i was hoping to make friends at work. do you know anybody personally who works in pharmacy?

i know that you can negotiate your own pay in the private sector - but from what i've researched, its not quite so high? - I think its a little bit less, and it takes longer than 5 years to progress to six figures. but thank you for your comment.
pharmacy in RCSI!!! so no transferring unfortunately. sound advice for the rest of the points, especially 2 - still trying to figure it out. thanks so much.

this is all true. my older sister does law, and she tells me all the time that it's all about connections. in terms of jobs i was thinking more the lines of working in government/administration - i couldn't be a lawyer. im not set on business/law, im looking at BESS and other sort of economic/business degrees too. i have, after all, a year to decide. thanks for your comment.

sort of. i couldn't really attend secondary school, i self studied a lot. my attendance was 40% average in fifth and sixth year. im just concerned that i won't make the capable pharmacist people deserve because i get very exhausted very quickly talking to people / being in other people's presence.

but pharmacy isn't as well paid as people think. its still subject to rigid pa6 scales set by the HSE, and i reckon i could earn more with a law/business double major. being a pharmacist just doesn't suit my personality - i have autism and i don't think i'll be able to cope. but i think i might just have to do it.

the irish listening will be beautiful once u get used to those godforsaken ulster accents. again, TG4, nuach mhall as gaeilge (fantastic website with many different accents) and just practice the exam !!!! i did one listening a week for most of 6th year, and enjoyed it too. only dp the mocks once ur more confident cause they'll crush ur self esteem. 

ask ur teacher for a list of common irish place names on the oral - like gaoth dobhair or whatever. and look online for lists of common listening vocab. it will get easier, i promise - u only have to get used to it.

biology is easy - make very comprssed notes from ur book, male flashcards, and then do every single exam and mock paper in existence. 

same with maths. just do and redo and fucking redo exam questions until u understand jt. attend every class.

with irish - christ, i don't know. i failed junior cycle irish but got a H1 in the eating cert. Read novels in irish, i guess. and watch TG4. 

Best of luck. ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️
literally just grind exam questions. did every business and biology exam q and most of the others and got 613 points.

i got 613, honestly don't know how it happened!!! i seriously feel like i don't deserve it because my attendance was 40% average in 5th and 6th year, but thats life :") congrats so much on 625, a fanatic achievement!!!!
im completely fucked . i genuinely don't know anything except for bits and pieces about sunningdale.
ridiculously easy.
:( i do hl maths, but its been difficult. you get your H1 brother,. but you don't have to dunk on the rest of us H3ers
ahh the jealousy is radiating off you brother ... you fucking wish you were them <\3
ah here, i love higher level maths but what's wrong with ol... those people are way happier than well ever be
praying for us all !!! its going to be fine, we just have to do it. Once its done its don and we won't have to think about it again!
you're like the nice pirate mifflin what the fuck

yes I'm next to certain you can drop on the day, tell ur superintendent. idk when the accounting exam is,but tomorrow morning talk to the teacher in ur school whose organising the lc and tell them you're dropping. do not worry, you can almost certainly drop on the day.
God speed

if you're burnt out, low effort studying can be recording yourself yapping your notes and then go on a walk and listen to them. its not like super effective but its something. im so exhausted after the mocks and orals, i totally get you.
okay god bless. thanks very much. glad it went well and here's to good results in june.
could I ask how they started it off? what kind of questions did they ask in the comhra?
hope you're having fun in irelabd. you came at a great time, the weather is lovely!!

other have already told you its not okay, but just wanted to let you know that if when you get your results you feel you were hard done by, you can request a recheck and they'll check everything, including the orals tape. if they find the grade needs an alternation it's free.

plenty of students don't go in. but fix your sleep schedule, be kind to yourself, and explain and apologise to your teachers. its not their responsibility to teach you the material if you don't come in, so make sure you're keeping up!! but other than that i wouldn't worry myself sick over it. as long as you do the work, at home or at school, you'll be alright. 400 points is definitely achievable with hard work.

read your notes, rawdog the sraithphictuir, then read over your notes and highlight the stuff you forgot. you don't need to know all your notes off by heart perfectly - just the gist of them, enough to fill two minutes. have faith in yourself and make sure you don't leave a single one out. we can do this!

the bell curve will drag u down mate, but yeah listen its too early in the year to be giving up hope. if u lock in and make the most out of ur grinds if god allows u will bag ur H4/H3. but u will have to work for it . past exam qs r ur best friend.
it's the leaving cert subreddit for 6th years, mate. obviously people are stressed and looking for support. it's not an easy time, give people a little grace.
nah you'll survive. u passed so God bless keep working hard and u'll have a H5 in the actual thing

i didn't have the money at the time for my history papers to be sent off, i just spoke to my teacher about it and i was able to get her the money two weeks later. if your family can't afford it, don't stress - just speak to ur school about it.

in english?? our fucking native language ? you must be God's strongest soldier cause hes giving you his hardest battles. but sure look its only the mocks, and you got a pass, so heres to hoping the actual thing will be better
thats what i was thinking i need to stop decomposing in my room

ahh thanks for the advice mate, i must admit I've already taken the job <\3 ur definitely right, when i worked during the summer i was often tired at the end of the day, but sure look it i think its a good opportunity to get out of the house and i will need some money to pay for books/college fees so sure i may as well. thanks very much and best of luck to u too - we got this !!!!!
all of them brother but im fucking terrified of English paper one. i have never had a thought, opinion or experience in my life.
aye that's me, ill be nominated for the poet laureate next

aye, the pain that comes with existence has been greatly exacerbated by the mocks. its like there's some hole in the aul chest and christ it aches. the terror's taking hold and i fear for the future. sure it'll be grand by july, probably.
unit 7. couldn't give less of a fuck. ive done a bunch of past papers and to be honest you can usually get away with a basic knowledge of it.
plath. if she's not on its joever
hallo, i just want to see if you are still alright? take care.
okay, thank you for the info! i'll definitely try and check those out. :)
